This dataset contains, for Bulgarian, Croatian, Czech, English, Estonian, Hungarian, Lithuanian, Macedonian, Persian, Polish, Resian, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovene, Ukrainian, some or all of the following resources:

other_download.title: Annotated Parallel "1984" Corpus
other_download.description: 15144 phrases taken from the George Orwell novel 1984. Each phrase is one resource, containing rdfs:labels in 3 languages: en, bg and cs in parallel. License information is contained

other_download.title: MULTEXT-East speech corpus.
other_download.description: Multext East speech corpus, containing 215 phrases, each with rdfs:labels in Romanian, Slovene, Estonian, Hungarian, (English, Czech, Bulgarian) in parallel.
